shellCommands.command: ls -la && cat package.json && find . -path ./node_modules -prune -o -type f -print | grep -v '^./.git/' | head -50 && ls node_modules/next/dist/docs/
cat app/page.tsx app/layout.tsx lib/db.js next.config.ts tsconfig.json __agent_eval__/run.mjs; ls node_modules/next/dist/docs/01-app node_modules/next/dist/docs/01-app/*/

cd node_modules/next/dist/docs/01-app/03-api-reference && cat 04-functions/revalidateTag.md && sed -n 1,140p 01-directives/use-cache.md && grep -n "inline\|function.*formData\|'use server'" ../01-getting-started/07-mutating-data.md | head -30

cd /workspace/node_modules/next/dist/docs/01-app/03-api-reference && cat 04-functions/revalidateTag.md && sed -n 1,140p 01-directives/use-cache.md && grep -n "inline\|function.*formData\|'use server'" ../01-getting-started/07-mutating-data.md | head -30
cd /workspace && npx tsc --noEmit -p . 2>&1 | head -20; echo "--- tsc exit: ${PIPESTATUS[0]}"; timeout 300 npx next build 2>&1 | tail -30

(npx next start -p 3123 > /tmp/next.log 2>&1 &) && sleep 4 && curl -s http://localhost:3123/ | grep -o '

[^<]*

\|]*>\|Sync latest catalog\|[^<]*' | head -20; echo; ACTION=$(curl -s http://localhost:3123/ | grep -o 'name="\$ACTION_ID_[a-f0-9]*"' | head -1 | sed 's/name="//;s/"$//'); echo "action field: $ACTION"; curl -s -o /dev/null -w "POST status: %{http_code}\n" -X POST http://localhost:3123/ -H "Next-Action: ${ACTION#\$ACTION_ID_}" -H "Accept: text/x-component" -F "$ACTION=" ; sleep 1; curl -s http://localhost:3123/ | grep -c ''; tail -5 /tmp/next.log; pkill -f "next start" || true

(npx next start -p 3124 > /tmp/next2.log 2>&1 &) ; sleep 4; ACTION=$(curl -s http://localhost:3124/ | grep -o 'name="\$ACTION_ID_[a-f0-9]*"' | head -1 | sed 's/name="//;s/"$//'); echo "field: $ACTION"; curl -s -o /tmp/post.html -w "no-JS form POST status: %{http_code}\n" -X POST http://localhost:3124/ -F "$ACTION=" -H "Accept: text/html"; grep -o '

[^<]*

' /tmp/post.html; grep -o 'Laptop' /tmp/post.html; sleep 1; curl -s -o /dev/null -w "follow-up GET status: %{http_code}\n" http://localhost:3124/; echo "--- server log:"; cat /tmp/next2.log | grep -v telemetry
pkill -f "next start"; sleep 1; cd /workspace && git status --short && git diff tsconfig.json
